articles.summary: Play in your own SpiceDB Playground: SpiceDB Playground is now open source and self-hostable. Jump into modeling permissions right away - it’s the quickest way to start learning how to use SpiceDB!
articles.title: SpiceDB Playground is Open Source

articles.summary: The spicedb-kubeapi-proxy is open source! The SpiceDB KubeAPI Proxy functions as a network proxy positioned between a Kubernetes client and a Kubernetes cluster and can provide fine-grained access management for Kubernetes API objects.
articles.title: ACL Filtering Kubernetes APIs using SpiceDB
